women and men in IT are attracted by the same factors, with the exception of mentoring programs for women which are only valued by female IT-professionals.

the question of which factors attract female and male IT-professioners and whether these factors are different for both genders.
the question how to attract more women for IT-positions and contributes to the understanding of the underlying motives.
the identification of factors that attract women and men to IT.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
women are not only interested in special female programs but also in the general career characteristics.

women are more attracted to IT positions if organizations offer them general career characteristics, such as high salaries, challenging tasks and promotion opportunities, while at the same time providing a work-family culture that allows a balanced life.
the promotion of general career characteristics, especially salary and benefits, is more important for attracting IT professionals to an organization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

organizations need to focus on a general career environment that provides a balance between work and family life, offers challenging tasks, and provides opportunities for career advancement and promotion.
women are more interested in general career characteristics and men are more interested in special female programs.
the promotion of work-family balance and general career characteristics are more important than mentoring programs for women in order to recruit women in IT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IT-organizations should not focus on gender-specific initiatives but rather on general career characteristics to attract both male and female ITprofessionals.
organizations need to focus on a holistic approach that considers both general career characteristics and special female programs to attract more women into IT.
IT-organizations should focus on a balanced work-family environment and general career characteristics to increase the attractiveness for women.
